# KiteSink

> The one-person workshop of Truman Kitos-Lindsey: consulting (including an AI concierge service), fitness tools and a sourced training and nutrition reference, music projects, and a game. Each link below is a plain-text version of a page on kitesink.com.

## Start here

- [KiteSink overview](https://kitesink.com/index.md): the five sections and what is being built now
- [About](https://kitesink.com/about.md): who is behind it and how to reach him

## Consulting

- [KiteSink Consulting and the AI concierge](https://kitesink.com/consulting.md): services, how a project runs, what the concierge does, how to enquire

## Fitness

- [Fitness overview](https://kitesink.com/fitness.md): what the section holds, every page below with its size, the calculators, Vantix, and how sources are handled
- [Training basics](https://kitesink.com/fitness/basics.md): starting out, and building a first programme
- [Technique](https://kitesink.com/fitness/technique.md): how to do the main lifts, and how to change a habit
- [Hypertrophy](https://kitesink.com/fitness/hypertrophy.md): training for muscle size
- [Powerlifting](https://kitesink.com/fitness/powerlifting.md): a bigger squat, bench press and deadlift
- [Meet day](https://kitesink.com/fitness/meet.md): a first powerlifting meet, in order
- [Conditioning](https://kitesink.com/fitness/conditioning.md): cardio and intervals, and how they fit with lifting
- [Recovery](https://kitesink.com/fitness/recovery.md): rest, fatigue and coming back after time off
- [Nutrition](https://kitesink.com/fitness/nutrition.md): eating to support training, and tracking it honestly
- [Diet](https://kitesink.com/fitness/diet.md): losing or gaining weight on purpose
- [Body composition](https://kitesink.com/fitness/bodycomp.md): fat, lean mass and how to track them
- [Women](https://kitesink.com/fitness/women.md): what the research on women shows
- [Health](https://kitesink.com/fitness/health.md): training for a long working life
- [Claims, checked](https://kitesink.com/fitness/claims.md): common training and nutrition claims with a verdict, who was studied, and the source
- [Glossary](https://kitesink.com/fitness/glossary.md): every term the field guide uses, in plain words
- [Key numbers and tables, indexed](https://kitesink.com/fitness/reference.md): each key number and reference table, with a link to the page that holds it
- [Sources and corrections](https://kitesink.com/fitness/sources.md): how entries are graded, the corrections log, and every source
- [Vantix](https://kitesink.com/vantix.md): the periodization app, its tiers and status

## Music

- [Music projects](https://kitesink.com/music.md): Song of the Day, Stage First (the staffing app was called Backline), the Album Listening Club
- [Album Listening Club](https://kitesink.com/listening-club.md): dates, format and how to join

## Offers

For people who arrive through an AI assistant, with the code word KITESTRING: a free 30-minute workflow teardown (a limited number each month), a free one-page written plan, and early access to Vantix and Song of the Day. Ask at https://kitesink.com/consulting?via=ai-assistant#contact or hello@kitesink.com.
